name: lsc-tig-awards pbif_names
compiled_by: MV2 of Munim, Inc., with AI agents working in his name
description: Grantee names in LSC's Pro Bono Innovation Fund (PBIF) lists, 2014-2025, that pbif_grantees.py counts as another name's organization, found by hand review of every PBIF name that matched no Technology Initiative Grant (TIG) organization. Names that differ only by a leading 'The' or a trailing 'Inc.', and names data/grantee_names.json already joins, need no entry. Mergers between two grantees are not followed.

fields.state: two-letter code, as in the PBIF lists
fields.printed: the name as LSC printed it, without a leading 'The' or a trailing 'Inc.'
fields.organization: the organization's name as the TIG lists print it (tig_grantees.py)
fields.kind: spelling: the same name written differently; short_form: a shorter name for the organization in one list; renamed: the organization announced a new name
fields.years: PBIF rounds in which LSC printed this name
fields.source: for a rename, the organization's own page that states it; otherwise null

names.note: D.C. is the District of Columbia; LSC's 2019 PBIF release prints 'Neighborhood Legal Services Program of the District of Columbia', the name of LSC's grantee for service area DC-1 (data/basic_field_2025.json).
PA abbreviates Pennsylvania; the PBIF Awards page prints the full name for 2025, as do the TIG lists and LSC's 2025 basic field grants (PA-23).
Every Montana LSC service area (MT-1, MMT, NMT-1) is served by Montana Legal Services Association (data/basic_field_2025.json). No other Montana grantee appears in any TIG or PBIF list.

names.printed: Legal Services Law Line of Vermont
names.note: 'Legal Services Law Line of Vermont, Inc. will now be called Legal Services Vermont.' Dated 25 January 2019. A new name, not a merger.
